entries.en: So, what'll it be? Billy-goat or the other one?
entries.ro: Deci, ce alegi? Țapul Billy sau celălalt?

entries.en: Other one. She's gonna love it.
entries.en_m: Other one. He's gonna love it.

entries.en: Yeah... Could say we had somethin' in common, heh.
entries.ro: Da... Aș putea spune că aveam ceva în comun, heh.

entries.en: Ruby Collins. Sloppy second for Grayson – after I banged 'er.
entries.ro: Ruby Collins. A doua variantă pentru Grayson, după ce m-am culcat cu ea.
Țapul Billy. Mai pe gustul meu.

entries.en: Jeremiah Grayson. Heard he's an operator for Smasher.
entries.ro: Jeremiah Grayson. Am auzit că e operator pentru Smasher.

entries.en: But you didn't hear that from me.
entries.ro: Dar n-ai auzit asta de la mine.
